title: Why '5' + 3 gives '53'
why_it_matters: This one explains half of all weird form-input bugs.
explanation: The + operator joins text if either side is a string. The other math operators, like - and *, convert strings into numbers instead. So the same inputs behave differently depending on the symbol. Convert with Number() before you add.
try_it: Quiz: what does '10' / '2' give? Predict first, then test.
